text: MILO: a diagnosis chat that shows its work
Sign in, then ask one question about the business
Question: requests and the time to assign them
The answer cites its sources; the steps are in the side panel
Tool calls: name, arguments, result and the policy decision
The full source opens with the passage highlighted in its context
A fact from the owner is recorded by a tool call (allowed)
A destructive action is blocked until the owner approves it
At the end: the summary and the proposed first spec
Every number comes from the recorded facts and the computed estimate
